title: Marconi believed the Magenta craft non-human

tellings.quote: Some documents on later family confirmations indicate Maronei genuinely believed the craft could be non-human.

plain: The radio pioneer Guglielmo Marconi is said to have believed that a craft reported to have come down near Magenta, Italy, in the 1930s "could be non-human." Michels says this rests on "some documents on later family confirmations," which he does not name. If true, it would put one of the great scientists of the age behind a crashed-craft story from before Roswell.
